newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks close up, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks close up, off early highs.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended higher on Friday after a deal with the International Monetary Fund on medium-term loans, but profit-taking ahead of the weekend pulled the market off earlier highs, dealers said.
Prices soared a day after the IMF agreed on a medium-term loan facility of at least $1.6 billion, dealer M. Ali said.
The Karachi 100-index closed 27.83 points, or 1.40 percent, higher at 2,009.64, after it touched 2,020.52 in early trade.
PSO rose 18 rupees to 420, HUBCO 1.40 to 56.30 and ICI 0.15 to 34.30. PTCL PTCA.KA fell 0.10 to 43.50 at 12.15 p.m.(0715 GMT). -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
